summary: Willis Lease Finance Corp filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a short-sale offering of 281,250 common shares at $192/share, executed by Morgan Stanley to facilitate hedging for convertible arbitrage investors concurrently subscribing to $200M (plus $30M over-allotment) of 2.50% convertible senior notes due 2031. The issuer receives no proceeds from this offering, and no new shares are issued. Both offerings are contingent on each other's completion. This is a routine capital market transaction (convertible note hedge-related share borrowing and sale) not constituting a special situation.
